exposure: Maternal serum hormones: corticotrophin-releasing hormone (CRH), dehydroepiandrosterone sulfate (DHEA-S), cortisol, estriol (E(3)), estradiol (E(2)), and progesterone (P(4))
maternal serum hormones along the maternal-fetal hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis
cohort: 88 nulliparous women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancies ≥39 weeks
finding: There were no significant differences in maternal serum hormone levels (CRH, DHEA-S, cortisol, E(3), E(2), and P(4)) between women who had a vaginal or cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: In low-risk nulliparous women undergoing full-term labor induction, there were no differences noted in a broad array of maternal-fetal HPA-axis hormones between women who had a vaginal or cesarean delivery.
